subject: Optimize Toolkit pilot: pricing options, quantization guidance, and ops guardrails
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@blueharbor.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@blueharbor.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit pilot inquiry

Hi Connor —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our ML team liked the caching ideas and the quantization tradeoffs you showed, but procurement needs a clear pilot pricing and a short list of recommended technical guardrails before we can sign a PO.

Specific asks: 
- A simple pilot price for 90 days (expected ~2M tokens/day peak) and an optional 6-month commit with lower unit pricing.
- Which models and quantization levels you recommend for our cold-start use cases (we run mixed short/long sequences, avg 220 tokens).
- Any runtime SLOs or operational limits you recommend (e.g., KV cache size, eviction policy) so our infra team can provision.

If you can send a one-page summary + an itemized pricing sheet we can get procurement moving.

Best,
Elena
Director, ML Platforms
BlueHarbor Logistics

P.S. procurement@blueharbor.com is on copy for contracting details.
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@blueharbor.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, procurement@blueharbor.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit pilot inquiry

Elena —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attaching a concise pilot proposal and the benchmark we ran that compares 8-bit vs 4-bit on the models you saw. High-level summary below; full details are in the attached pricing_sheet_v3.xlsx and benchmark_report_8bit_vs_4bit.pdf.

Pilot options (90-day):
- No-commit pilot (metered): $0.020 per 1k generation tokens, $0.006 per 1k embedding tokens; includes basic Optimize tool suggestions.
- Light commit (90d, $30k upfront credits): effective price ~$0.015 per 1k gen tokens during the pilot; credits expire at the end of pilot.

6-month commit (recommended if you go broader): tiered commit with volume bands (up to 10M tokens/day peak) and a 12% discount off the metered rates + Optimize credits for intelligent batching (shown in spreadsheet).

Technical guidance / quantization: 
- For short sequences (<256 tokens) we recommend 4-bit quantization on model BH-Base-XL* for highest cost savings with marginal accuracy delta in our evals.
- For long sequences and heavy KV cache usage (avg >512 tokens), stick to 8-bit or mixed-precision — 4-bit increases KV cache churn and leads to higher latency tail for long-context retrieval.
- We include prefix/KV caching with a sliding-window eviction policy (LRU tuned to your sequence distribution). Start with a 24k KV window and monitor hit-rate for 2 weeks; we can adjust dynamically.

Operational SLOs we recommend for the pilot: 
- Median generation latency target: <120ms for token streaming (typical for short seqs on curated model/quant).
- 95th percentile: <400ms on provisioned Dedicated pool; fallback to hosted model variants if Dedicated pool saturation >85%.

Attachments: pricing_sheet_v3.xlsx (itemized), benchmark_report_8bit_vs_4bit.pdf (accuracy vs cost), MAP_v1.docx (mutual action plan template).

Next steps: If procurement is comfortable I can draft a short SOW + PO and run it through our commercial team for a 6-month commit quote.

—Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@blueharbor.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, procurement@blueharbor.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit pilot inquiry

Looping in a commercial note — Elena, quick clarifications from our side so procurement has what they need: 

Pricing mechanics we propose:
- Pilot credit pool: Redwood invoices upfront for the credit pool (applies to tokens and Optimize usage). Any unused credits after 90 days are refundable up to 60% or can be rolled into a 6-month commit at pro-rated value.
- Commit discounts: discounts apply to metered rates and are applied retroactively to usage once commit threshold is crossed in a billing period.

Discount negotiation levers (for your vendor team):
- Volume commit (tokens/day) — primary lever for discount depth.
- Minimum monthly invoice floor — helps us reserve Dedicated capacity and improves latency guarantees.
- Technical guardrails (quantization scope): if BlueHarbor agrees to limit 4-bit quantization to specific non-critical models and test prompt-suite, we can extend an additional 6% discount on committed tiers (risk-sharing).

Operational items — Aditya, please confirm whether the 24k KV/window and LRU recommendation is safe to include as a contractual operational guardrail for the pilot (we plan to offer dynamic tuning but need initial constraints).

Elena — happy to tailor the mutual action plan in MAP_v1.docx to include acceptance criteria (latency targets, RL eval pass rates) so both sides have a clear exit/scale trigger.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Commercials | Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@blueharbor.com>
Cc: procurement@blueharbor.com
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit pilot inquiry

Lauren / Connor / Elena —

Confirming technical stance: the 24k KV window with LRU eviction is a conservative starting point for the pilot given the sequence distribution Elena shared (~220 tokens average, occasional 1k+ spikes). A few implementation notes: 

- We will instrument KV hit-rate and tail latency dashboards (available in Redwood Console) and set an automated alert if 95th percentile token latency increases >20% vs baseline.
- 4-bit quantization will be allowed only for the models listed in the attached benchmark (we flag models that failed regression checks). If you want broader 4-bit rollout during the pilot, we require a short A/B eval on a pre-agreed prompt set for 3 days before production flip.
- For the pilot we recommend enabling Prefix caching for templates and cold-start warmup; this reduces cold-start cost by ~18% in our tests.

If that all looks good from procurement side, Connor — happy for you to circulate the SOW + PO draft.

—Aditya
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
